player_prompt.intro:
Ni wewe Mugenzi {player_id} muri **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Ohereze ingendo yawe kama **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = ni mini-bodi ya kubaka
• *micro* = ni mraba muri mini-bodi
Urwego `[7 8]` ➜ shirikisha alama yawe muri mini-bodi 7, mraba 8, na
fasha ugenzi wawe akine muri mini-bodi 8 inyuma.

Ni wewe `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Igikorwa cyo kwimura kigomba kuba muburyo [macro micro] hamwe nimero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Buri cyuho kigomba kuba kiri hagati ya 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, umurongo cyangwa ikorosi biri hanze y'intera.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Umukinnyi agomba gukina ku mbuga ikurikiraho.

game_action.played: Mugenzi {player_id} yakinnye muri mini-bodi {macro_idx}, mwanya {micro_idx} (umurongo {row}, umwanya {col}). Mugenzi {opponent_id} agomba kubaka muri {nxt_txt} sasa.

outcome.win: Umukinnyi {player_id} atsinda umukino wa Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
outcome.draw: Umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa!
